clause: Bit-depth 8/16/32 + HDR merge + HDR/tone-mapping + 32-bit workflow + capability state [STU-RAS-033]

scope.summary: Support 8-, 16-, and 32-bit-per-channel documents; 32-bit float stores HDR luminance beyond display range. Implement: merge-bracketed-exposures-to-HDR (with ghost removal and tone-mapping); HDR Toning and Shadows/Highlights tone-mapping between 32/16/8-bit; a 32-bit HDR editing workflow with a preview-exposure control; and surface the documented reduced tool/filter/blend-mode availability at 32-bit as inspectable capability state rather than silent failure. Bit-depth conversions are model-steerable commands subject to STU-RAS-003.
expected_tests: live: merge a bracket of exposures to a 32-bit HDR document (ghost removal on); adjust preview-exposure; tone-map down to 16/8-bit via HDR Toning
test: at 32-bit, unavailable tools/filters/blend-modes are reported as inspectable capability state (queryable), not silent no-ops
acceptance_criteria_original: 8/16/32-bit documents; HDR merge with ghost removal; HDR toning between depths
32-bit reduced availability is inspectable state; conversions promotion-gated

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-033]** Studio MUST support 8-, 16-, and 32-bit-per-channel documents. 32-bit floating point MUST store HDR luminance beyond display range. Studio MUST provide: a merge-bracketed-exposures-to-HDR operation (with ghost removal and tone-mapping); tone-mapping between 32/16/8-bit; a 32-bit HDR editing workflow with a preview-exposure control; and the reduced tool/filter/blend-mode availability at 32-bit MUST be surfaced as inspectable capability state rather than silent failure.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
